detail: Critical manufacturing lifecycle method does not show an obvious companyId scope in its data access.
recommendation: Scope every production order, item, BOM, warehouse, and consumption lookup by companyId. Cross-company references must fail before any mutation.

detail: Completion-like method has no obvious already-completed guard.
recommendation: Make completion exactly-once: if already Completed, return the existing order without adding finished stock again. Lock/reload the production order before changing status or stock.
